question: As an immunosuppressant, rapamycin:

options.opb: It inhibits the new synthesis of nucleotides with guanine.
options.opc: Blocks costimulatory pathways of T lymphocyte
options.opd: Blocks the proliferation of T lymphocytes

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Rapamycin" -> "Inhibits the transcription of IL-2" -> 80% CHAIN: "Rapamycin" -> "Blocks costimulatory pathways of T lymphocytes" -> 90% CHAIN: "Rapamycin" -> "Blocks the proliferation of T lymphocytes" -> 80%
analysis: Rapamycin is known to inhibit the proliferation of T lymphocytes by blocking the signaling pathway downstream of the IL-2 receptor, thereby preventing the cells from progressing through the cell cycle.
